dedicated.name: Mercure's Dark Stone

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Mercure by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"It's a shame it's just a mere fragment... but with materials of this caliber, I should be able to summon a tremendous darkness."

After the temple was destroyed and the Goddess Stone was shattered, the elderly high priest attempted to pin the blame on the twins, Branze and Bransel, and have them exiled. Protesting their innocence, Branze resisted the accusation, but the twins ultimately found themselves on the verge of being cast out of the temple. Meanwhile, the true culprit behind the incident —the black magician Mercure— gazed upon the stolen stone fragment and reveled in the success of his plan to summon the darkness.

lore:
Mercure is a black magician from Telus.
He was born into a family schooled in white magic, but their strict rules, traditions, and ethical constraints prevented him from pursuing the research he desperately wanted to conduct. This frustrated him endlessly.
One day, he encountered a black magician whose unrestrained, effective, and ruthless magic fascinated him.
Mercure took the black magician as his master and secretly began learning the forbidden arts. As a result, he ascended to a new level of power.
However, his magic grew stronger at an unnatural pace, causing his family to become suspicious. They followed Mercure and discovered he had dabbled in black magic.
Mercure was exiled from his family, but he was actually truly happy.
Now free from the shackles of family restrictions, he was able to live with his master, gaining knowledge and awakening the essence of black magic.
At the time, Telus was in chaos, engulfed by constant wars and monster invasions. This turmoil made it easy for Mercure to obtain the materials and sacrifices required for his experiments.
In time, his constant monster-slaying made him become known as something like a knight.
But as the war raged on, Telus eventually fell into ruin, and Mercure could no longer procure the materials needed for his research. In desperate need of resources to continue his work, he sought a new path.
That's when Platin extended a hand out to him.
Platin claimed to have discovered a way to another world and offered Mercure a chance to join the Dark Knights.
A new world.
A place to gain new knowledge!
A place where he could conduct new experiments!
Without hesitation, Mercure accepted the offer.
